description: Somos Estelar 2, parte del equipo de FRC Estelar #12119
summary: Agro-Estelar is a bilingual (Spanish/English), mobile-friendly web platform from Team Estelar (NASA Space Apps 2026, Ciudad del Este). It uses NASA satellite data to help Paraguayan farmers and communities decide better: where and when fires burn, how much it rains, when floods may happen, and what to plant next. It starts in Paraguay, but the engine works for any point on Earth.
details:
What it does

- Fire: a month-by-year calendar that merges MODIS and VIIRS detections so the same fire isn't counted twice, plus a "what to expect" view based on past years.

- Climate: rainfall, temperature and heavy-rain days since 1981 (NASA POWER), with plain-language explanations.

- Local alerts: active fires nearby, 7-day fire-risk, heavy rain and river flow (NASA FIRMS and Open-Meteo/GloFAS).

- Rotation: next-crop suggestions based on nitrogen, water in a dry year and fire season.

- Floods: a digital simulation of urban water with virtual sensors. It is not a real alert system.

AgroEstelar mainly uses TypeScript and JavaScript.
